Ahmad Tibi told Al Hadath the Joint List's terms for Eisenkot:

"We want from Eisenkot a safety net for our Arab community in exchange for a safety net for his government."

They are not seeking ministries, he said.

The USS Roosevelt will not enter CENTCOM's area until mid November.

The carrier docks in Singapore tomorrow for a short port visit, a U.S. official told Barak Ravid.

🚨 The military option on Iran remains on the table despite the midterm loss, U.S. officials tell i24NEWS.

Trump may choose limited strikes on nuclear facilities.

Iran is looking at Russian gas pipelines to cover its shortage and resell to the region.

After meeting Putin, Mohsen Rezaei said they discussed pipelines so Tehran can ease its shortage and sell Russian gas to neighbors.

Iraqi PM al Zaidi told President Trump that Iraq will not allow its territory to be used to attack neighboring countries, per the PM's office.

They also discussed dialogue and diplomacy to keep the conflict from widening.

Channel 12: Avigdor Lieberman is no longer ruling out a government that includes ultra Orthodox parties.

The shift could give Gadi Eisenkot a path to build a coalition and remove Netanyahu from power.

Kann News: a Saudi source says Riyadh has no personal issue with Netanyahu, but his policy blocks peace.

"He doesn't want peace, but escalation." Normalization stays off the table while he leads.

Hackers remotely pushed freezers at US military commissaries, European stores and blood plasma suppliers to extreme temperatures by exploiting exposed refrigeration controllers.

CISA, the Pentagon and international police are investigating.

Nigeria: Islamic State West Africa Province posted a photo of militants with weapons captured from the Nigerian Army.

Fighters hold Poland made FB Beryl M762 and PAC AKMS rifles. The Beryl has railed handguards and a Romanian wire side folding stock.

Former IDF chief Gadi Eisenkot received the backing of 67 of the Knesset's 120 members for the first chance to form Israel's next government.

The recommendations were delivered to President Isaac Herzog.

The State Department denied reports that Secretary of State Marco Rubio was weighing resignation after the midterms.

Official Dylan Johnson called the claims "completely baseless fake news."

Nusseibeh makes her case for the UN top job

@Lana_Nusseibeh
National Guard boats, humvees and marked police cars will patrol Washington DC streets and waterways through year end after War Secretary Pete Hegseth ordered the expanded deployment.
Harmeet Dhillon has stepped down as Assistant Attorney General for Civil Rights at the Justice Department, according to reports.

🚨 Houthis claim they attacked King Fahd International Airport in Dammam, Saudi Arabia.

There is no Saudi confirmation so far.

Netanyahu and his allies claim Arab voter turnout stole Israel's recent election.

Election officials say any foul play under review could not have changed the outcome.

Oil products tanker VELOS SAPPHIRE was struck about 50 nautical miles north of Madinat ash Shamal, Qatar, sustaining damage.

One seafarer is reported missing.

Melania Trump received the Order of Princess Olga at the White House for her role in the Oleshky ceasefire.

Nearly 800 residents left by bus convoy during the pause in fighting.

Tony Blair, a senior member of Trump's Board of Peace, held separate meetings in Israel today with Netanyahu and President Herzog.

Gadi Eisenkot is on Blair's schedule for tomorrow.

Iran is now weighing "concrete proposals" on its nuclear program, officials say.

Tehran's return to the nuclear file suggests Qatar's mediation to head off a full blown US Iran war is starting to gain traction.
